descriptionMarkdown:
4.2 Shrine Worlder
Raised in devotion, ritual, sacrifice, and Imperial worship.
Allowed Species: Human, rare Ratling.
Skill Proficiency: Religion and either Persuasion or 
Intimidation.
Litany of Resolve: Once per long rest, you can give 
yourself or one ally within 30 ft. advantage on a Wisdom 
saving throw.
Sacred Hatred: Once per turn, when you damage a 
heretic, daemon, mutant, witch, traitor, or xenos with
a weapon attack or class feature, you deal an additional 
1d4 + 1 radiant damage.
This damage represents zeal, ritual fury, and trained 
hatred rather than true divine magic.
